intro_body: Every TrueNorth house is a real home on a real street — not a facility. Small by design, so nobody disappears into the crowd. Availability below is updated by our team, not a guess.

homes.name: Oak Cliff House
highlights: Two blocks from the bus line
homes.description: A 1940s brick bungalow with a deep front porch and a backyard that gets used. Eight men, two house leaders, one rule everybody agrees to on day one.

homes.name: Denton House
homes.description: Our largest house, and the one that runs the tightest. Good fit if you're working or in school and need structure that holds without hovering.

homes.name: Arlington House
homes.description: Six women, one kitchen table, and a standing Thursday dinner nobody skips. Currently full — the waitlist moves faster than you'd think.
